items.title: Wavy Edged Woodland Leaves
items.alt: Two oval green woodland leaves with gently wavy margins and strong evenly paired side veins sit on a short twig, one tilted enough to show fine soft edge hairs.
items.description: Two oval green woodland leaves with gently wavy margins and strong evenly paired side veins sit on a short twig, one tilted enough to show fine soft edge hairs.

items.title: Long Serrated Leaf
items.alt: One long lance-shaped leaf with a sharply serrated edge, strong central midrib and many straight parallel side veins ending at the teeth, deep green natural botanical realism, complete petiole.
items.description: One long lance-shaped leaf with a sharply serrated edge, strong central midrib and many straight parallel side veins ending at the teeth, deep green natural botanical realism, complete petiole.

items.title: Palmate Compound Leaf
items.alt: One complete palmately compound leaf has five distinct oblong toothed leaflets joined at one shared petiole point, natural size hierarchy and no single fused leaf blade.
items.description: One complete palmately compound leaf has five distinct oblong toothed leaflets joined at one shared petiole point, natural size hierarchy and no single fused leaf blade.

items.title: Pinnate Compound Leaf
items.alt: One complete pinnately compound green leaf with three opposite pairs of oval pointed leaflets plus one terminal leaflet, all seven attach to one clear central rachis, no flowers.
items.description: One complete pinnately compound green leaf with three opposite pairs of oval pointed leaflets plus one terminal leaflet, all seven attach to one clear central rachis, no flowers.

items.title: Three Leaf Clover
items.alt: A tiny complete clover sprig with three softly heart-shaped green leaflets meeting at one point, faint pale chevrons and one slender curved stalk, no four-leaf mutation or text.

items.title: Trailing Ivy Leaves
items.alt: A short gently curving ivy vine carries five small dark green angular lobed leaves with pale radiating veins, clear petiole attachment and complete vine endpoints, no wall or pot.
